title: Overtime Pay Calculator
description: Calculate gross pay with regular hours, time-and-a-half overtime and double-time hours.
howto: Enter your hourly rate and regular hours.
Add overtime hours (1.5×) and double-time hours (2×) if any.
Read the full pay breakdown and your effective hourly rate.

faqs.a: In the US, the FLSA requires 1.5× pay for hours over 40 in a workweek for non-exempt workers. Some states add daily overtime rules.
2× the regular rate, required in some states (e.g. California for hours over 12 in a day) or by union contracts.
No — it is taxed as ordinary income. Withholding may look higher on a big check, but the tax rate is the same.
